name: Pallet Dispenser

capacity.label: Magazine capacity
capacity.desc: How many empty pallets a full magazine holds: the positions it grips, from the bottom up. A stack loaded taller than this keeps the pallets above the top position, standing loose on the stack.

stock.label: Pallets at start
stock.desc: Retired: place pallets in the magazine instead (Fill, in the Inspector). A scene saved with a count here still starts with that many new pallets when none are placed.

autoFeed.label: Auto dispense
autoFeed.desc: With no program driving the dispense tag, keep the bay stocked: set down the next pallet whenever the last one has been carried clear. Off, it dispenses only on Use.

autoRefill.label: Reload by itself when empty
autoRefill.desc: Fill an empty magazine with new pallets a few seconds after the last one leaves it and the bay is clear. Off (the default), it waits to be loaded: set a stack of two or more pallets down in it from its open -Z side.

liftSpeed.label: Lift speed (m/s)
liftSpeed.desc: Carriage speed up and down. A cycle travels about two pallet heights plus the hold gap twice, so this sets most of the cycle time.

forkTime.label: Fork stroke time (s)
forkTime.desc: How long the forks take to go in or out of a pallet.

standHeight.label: Stand height (m)
standHeight.desc: Height of the conveying surface the pallets are set down on. The part stands with its origin on that surface, and its columns run from here down to the floor.

frameColor.label: Frame color
frameColor.desc: Paint of the columns, beams, ties and knee braces.

guardColor.label: Guide color
guardColor.desc: Paint of the magazine guides and the lift carriage, the parts that move or touch the pallets.

palletSize.label: Pallet size
palletSize.desc: The pallets it holds: its guides and forks are set for this footprint, Fill places pallets of it, and the new pallets it makes are this size.

palletColor.label: Pallet color
palletColor.desc: Tint over the pallet wood of the new pallets it is filled with (Pallets at start, Reload by itself). White leaves them untinted, like a hand-placed pallet. A pallet loaded into it keeps its own.

mass.label: Mass (kg)
mass.desc: Mass of the new pallets it is filled with. A pallet loaded into it keeps its own.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this part to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on.

dispenseTag.label: Dispense tag (rising edge)
dispenseTag.desc: Each rising edge dispenses ONE pallet; holding it true does not dispense more. While a program drives this tag it owns the machine: Use and Auto dispense stand aside.

enableTag.label: Enable tag
enableTag.desc: The dispenser moves only while this is true. Drop it and the carriage and forks stop where they are, holding the stack; raise it and the cycle carries on from there. A request while it is false is refused. Wire it to the line running, so a Stop or a trip holds the dispense and a Start finishes it. Leave it empty and the dispenser is always enabled.

busyTag.label: Busy tag
busyTag.desc: True from a dispense request until the stack is lifted clear of the pallet it set down. Hold the conveyor under the magazine until it falls.

bayTag.label: Pallet in bay tag
bayTag.desc: The bay photo-eye: true while a pallet stands under the magazine. A line that keeps one pallet waiting dispenses whenever this is false and it is not busy.

countTag.label: Dispensed count tag
countTag.desc: Running total of pallets set down.

levelTag.label: Pallets left tag
levelTag.desc: How many pallets are still in the magazine. Zero means it is parked, waiting to be loaded.
